title: W0 Runtime Launch Challenge
description: Closed output of the pinned bootstrap PREPARE phase in PREPARE→VALIDATE→ADMIT. PREPARE verifies all pins, creates and rehashes the fresh temp validator closure, derives exact source+temp/invocation digests, predeclares the separate operator-external authorization evidence root, generates runId plus at least 256-bit nonce, writes this record, and exits with pythonStarted=false. The authority observes/locks exact identities before prelaunch. VALIDATE accepts this byte-identical challenge plus signed PREPARE/pre/post paths; ADMIT accepts it plus the complete external authorization/admission set. Direct invocation or cleanup before valid ADMIT is invalid.

resolvedLaunchChallengePath.description: PREPARE writes this record here as its final operation and exits. The challenge cannot include its own hash or file identity.

resolvedAuthorizationEvidenceRoot.description: Predeclared operator-external directory, disjoint from every protected project/package/baseline/Skill/temp path, where VALIDATE/ADMIT may create only the exact run-authorization evidence set.

operatorExpectedConfigSha256.description: Out-of-band operator-authorized CLI scalar captured before ConfigPath is read. It exact-matches configSha256 and every downstream signed record.

configSha256.description: Locally recomputed raw ConfigPath hash; must equal operatorExpectedConfigSha256 before config parsing.

supportArtifactSetSha256.description: Canonical digest of the exact three ordinal-copyPath-sorted closed {copyPath,bytes,sha256} records for gen_index.py, state_readiness.py, and strict_json.py in the prepared temp root.

tempCopySetSha256.description: Canonical digest of every regular file below resolvedTempRoot after PREPARE, sorted by relative POSIX path as closed {path,bytes,sha256}. It includes exactly validator entrypoint plus three support files and nothing else.

absolutePath.description: Windows local-drive absolute path for W0 lifecycle v1. POSIX, UNC, device, ADS, and relative paths are invalid.

$comment: Cycle boundary: this challenge file is excluded from projectInputTreeSha256, tempCopySetSha256, and readInputSetSha256 because it contains those digests. It is not an unprotected omission: prelaunch/postexecution bind its resolved path, raw launchChallengeSha256, and authority-observed challengeFileIdentity as a distinct proof-sealing external challenge.
